title: GFG: ZigZag Tree Traversal
description: Given a binary tree in level-order array `nodes`, return the zigzag level order traversal (left-to-right on level 1, right-to-left on level 2, alternating). Return a flat list of node values.
solution:
def zigzag_traversal(nodes: list) -> list[int]:
    if not nodes or nodes[0] is None:
        return []
    res = []
    idx = 0
    sz = 1
    left_to_right = True
    while idx < len(nodes):
        level = [x for x in nodes[idx:idx + sz] if x is not None]
        if level:
            res.extend(level if left_to_right else reversed(level))
            left_to_right = not left_to_right
        idx += sz
        sz *= 2
    return res
explanation: Alternating directional flag reverses every second depth level in O(N) time.
